title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon
description: A middle-aged man with only one passion in his life meets a fitting end in a traffic accident. That’s where most stories would end, but instead, this is when his story begins when he’s reborn as what he admired the most in life–a vending machine! But his new lease on life happens in the worst place possible–what can a vending machine do in a monster-infested dungeon when he can’t speak or even move on his own?

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x1
episodes_data.description: After his untimely death, our unlikely hero finds himself in another world, reincarnated as a vending machine. Now his life revolves around selling things to people, but he's stuck in the middle of nowhere with no sign of any customers.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x2
episodes_data.description: The Hunters Association hires Lammis and Boxxo to provide food during a frog fiend hunt, with a ragtag group acting as their bodyguards. But things turn ominous when the fiends prove to be more numerous than expected.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x3
episodes_data.description: The expedition returns to find the village has been attacked, but fortunately the damage is limited. Boxxo and Lammis discover they both have plenty of ways to help during the recovery effort.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x4
episodes_data.description: A gang of thieves carts Boxxo away so they can extract his money, but the real surprise turns out to be the individual who's supposed to figure out how to pull off the theft.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x5
episodes_data.description: Boxxo is already well known throughout the village for the items he's sold to date, and now he begins to find new ways to assist various residents with their problems.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x6
episodes_data.description: Boxxo falls into a new stratum, and there he has an unexpected encounter with some hungry hunters who think he's nothing more than a convenient magic item.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x7
episodes_data.description: Boxxo falls into a new stratum, and there he has an unexpected encounter with some hungry hunters who think he's nothing more than a convenient magic item.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x8
episodes_data.description: Boxxo, Lammis, and a large formidable group go on a campaign in the Labyrinth stratum to defeat the local stratum lord. Meanwhile, Kerioyl reveals his reasons for targeting such foes in the first place.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x9
episodes_data.description: Director Bear commissions Boxxo, Lammis, Hulemy, and the Band of Gluttons to survey the exterior of the labyrinth. Joining them is a powerful hunter who has more going on than meets the eye.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x10
episodes_data.description: Munami and the Restaurant Union decide to hold an eating contest, but that's a risky venture given the appetites of some of the locals. Can Boxxo save the day once again?

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x11
episodes_data.description: Captain Kerioyl wants a group to explore the Dead's Lament stratum and eventually defeat its stratum lord, but there's a big problem. Lammis can't cope with the scary monsters inhabiting the place!

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon 1x12
episodes_data.description: Boxxo and friends track down the King of Souls stratum lord and launch an attack on him. But they face their greatest trial yet when the plan goes badly off the rails.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: A large group of ace hunters gather to the Dead's Lament stratum to take down the Netherlord once and for all.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Boxxo and crew have to defend what's left of the Clearflow Lake stratum's village against a horde of monsters.

episodes_data.description: To get rid of the monsters in Clearflow Lake stratum, first the hole in the defensive wall needs to be filled.

episodes_data.description: A small group including Boxxo goes to the Origin stratum to help fight off the attacking monster horde there.

episodes_data.description: In order to securely evacuate the Origin stratum, the enemy commander must first be found and neutralized.

episodes_data.description: The lord of the Dark Forest stratum needs to be defeated, but nothing seems to provoke it into attacking.

episodes_data.description: To help boost morale, Munami holds a popularity contest amongst the ladies living in Clearflow Lake stratum.

episodes_data.title: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: When Hevee departs for the Scorching Sand stratum to deal with a personal matter, the other heroes follow him.

episodes_data.description: While Hevee sorts out his unfinished business with Tashtay, some unexpected foes arrive to complicate matters.
